Variation DEFAULT (red, visor core #FA4E4D). Proposed source for classic; mapping awaits approval.
Variation ARCTIC (blue, #4379FF). Proposed for the game's cobalt skin, not its arctic skin (name clash, see brief.md); mapping awaits approval.
Variation VOID (purple, #C64DFA). Proposed for violet, lifted to #CB5EFF. This swatch also tints the hood fabric purple; the proposal keeps the suit black on every skin.
Variation SAND (gold, #FCC559). Proposed for sunset. The chest slash stays red in this swatch (generation slip); every accent recolours.
Variation STEALTH (white, #F7F4FD). Proposed for arctic (cool white #EAF2FF) and, muted, for carbon (#949FAD).
